task: Sectional coverage and blueprint balance analysis
methodology: Direct grep of Section field and question_state across all 5 pack files + case file scan

section_balance.description: Item counts closely align with IMA blueprint weights (all within 1.35pp). The inventory is well-balanced by section volume across 2,539 section-tagged items.
section_balance.note: One item in Pack D lacks a Section field — 2,539 section-tagged items vs 2,540 total QIDs.

Pack D Section F has 74 items (1 fewer than standard 75)

certification_coverage_by_section.methodology_note: Per-section certification counts from context-window scan — directionally correct but individual counts may have ±5 item error due to dual-block architecture in Packs A/C/D. Pack-level totals are authoritative.

certification_coverage_by_section.corrected_assessment: Earlier SESSION_STATUS estimate of Section F at ~67% certified was significantly incorrect. Sections A-D are fully certified across all 5 packs. The 242 non-certified items (9.5% of pool) are concentrated in Sections E and F of Packs A (19 items), C (112 items), and D (111 items). Section E has more non-certified items than Section F, not less.
certification_coverage_by_section.learner_pool_risk: LOW — 2,298 of 2,540 items (90.5%) are Certified and in the delivery pool. The 242 non-certified items are excluded. Sections A-D have 100% learner pool coverage.

cross_pack_isomorphism.finding: All 5 packs use a near-identical section-quantity template: A=75, B=100, C=100, D=75, E=75, F=75. Exceptions: Pack E Section E has 115 (includes 40 R-series supplemental items), Pack D Section F has 74 (1 missing), Pack D has 1 item with no Section field.
cross_pack_isomorphism.assessment: MIXED — This is both a feature (consistency) and a bug (redundancy risk). Every pack is a structural near-clone with identical section boundaries. The cross-pack redundancy means the effective unique item count may be lower than 2,540 if items across packs are template-generate near-duplicates.
cross_pack_isomorphism.dl012_relevance: DL-012 found 140 clones across Pack C/D Section E from the 5-item rotation template producing near-identical items. The broader risk: other sections may have partial cloning across packs. Pack B (independent authoritative pipeline) and Pack E (different pipeline) are structurally distinct. Packs A/C/D share a common template lineage.

template_pipeline_relationship.group_1_packs_acd: Pack A + Pack C + Pack D share a common 5-item rotation template pipeline. Higher risk of inter-pack near-duplication.
template_pipeline_relationship.group_2_pack_b: Pack B uses an independent authoritative pipeline. Structurally distinct item authoring.
template_pipeline_relationship.group_3_pack_e: Pack E uses a third independent pipeline. Distinct JSON structure, different ExplanationWrong field conventions.

case_study_coverage.section_coverage: All sections A-F covered in all 5 case files (15 cases per file, sections distributed across cases)
case_study_coverage.certified_cases: scored_cases.js: 15/15 cases fully certified (S530/S537). scored_cases2-5: partial — production status not fully applied.
case_study_coverage.dl032_status: Case difficulty uniformly labeled Moderate. scored_cases.js partially remediated (S530/S537). scored_cases2-5 not yet remediated.

findings.title: Blueprint item-count balance is EXCELLENT
findings.detail: All 6 sections are within 1.35pp of IMA blueprint weight. Section E is slightly over (+1.35pp) due to 40 supplemental R-series items in Pack E. The inventory volume is well-distributed.

findings.title: Cross-pack isomorphism raises unique-content concern
findings.detail: All 5 packs share identical section structures (A=75, B=100, C=100, D=75, E=75, F=75). The 5-item rotation template pipeline produced identical section counts in Packs A/C/D. A cross-pack uniqueness audit is recommended — how many pairs of items across Packs A and C (same section/position) are template-generated near-clones? DL-012 found 140 clones for Section E alone.

findings.title: Certification bottleneck: Packs C and D Sections E/F
findings.detail: 242 items (9.5%) are not yet Certified — concentrated in Packs C (112) and D (111), plus Pack A (19). Sections A-D are 100% certified across all packs. The gap is in Sections E (Internal Controls) and F (Technology & Analytics). Sections E and F in Packs C/D need certification passes.

findings.title: Section E is the largest section due to R-series expansion
findings.detail: Pack E Section E has 115 items (75 standard + 40 R-series P1-E-R01 through P1-E-R40). This makes Internal Controls (415 items total) the largest section, 1.35pp above IMA blueprint weight. The R-series adds 40 supplemental items to an already well-covered domain.

findings.title: Pack D Section F has 74 items (1 missing)
findings.detail: All other sections in all other packs are exact (A=75, B=100, C=100, D=75, E=75, F=75). Pack D Section F has 74 items — 1 item is either missing or has a malformed Section field.

findings.title: Pack D has 1 item with no Section field
findings.detail: Sum of section-tagged items across Pack D = 499, but Pack D has 500 QuestionIDs. One item has no Section field — a data integrity gap.

findings.title: Case study section coverage is comprehensive but certification is front-loaded
findings.detail: All 6 sections have case coverage across all 5 case files. Only scored_cases.js is fully certified. scored_cases2-5 need certification passes. DL-032 (uniform Moderate difficulty labeling) remains unresolved for scored_cases2-5.

findings.title: Three distinct authoring pipelines create structural debt
findings.detail: Pack A/C/D share a template rotation pipeline (clones, DL-008, DL-026). Pack B is an authoritative independent pipeline. Pack E is a third independent pipeline with different field conventions (DL-018, DL-021). Any cross-pack tooling must handle all three structural formats.

recommendations.action: Certify Packs C and D Sections E and F
recommendations.detail: 242 non-certified items block full learner pool coverage. Prioritize Sections E and F in Packs C (112 items) and D (111 items), then Pack A Section E residual (19 items).

Run a stem-similarity scan comparing items at the same section-position across Packs A, C, and D. Quantify how many items are near-clones vs. genuinely distinct. This was done for Section E (140 clones found) but not for other sections.

recommendations.action: Fix Pack D Section field gap
recommendations.detail: Identify the 1 item in Pack D with no Section field and add the correct Section tag. Also investigate why Section F has 74 items (not 75).
Case study items in scored_cases2-5 all labeled Moderate. Recalibrate based on cognitive demand analysis (similar to scored_cases.js S530/S537 remediation).
recommendations.estimated_effort: ~60 cases × 5 items each = 300 items to recalibrate
